u0: No key has been acquired yet. Progress is at zero: the immediate objective is to locate and pick up the yellow key, transitioning to the first possession state. The door remains closed and the goal unreachable.
u1: First key possession achieved. The agent is currently carrying the yellow key; progress is one of two required possession intervals. The next objective is to drop the key (losing it before the door is open) to set up the second possession. Opening the door while holding the key does not advance this task's counting and leaves the agent stuck here if it drops afterward, so prioritize the drop while the door is closed.
u2: Key has been lost after the first possession, with the door still closed. One possession interval is complete; the next objective is to pick the yellow key back up. This starts the second possession interval and satisfies the task's two-possession condition, so acquiring the key now moves to the final state.
u3: Success: the agent has possessed the key on at least two separate moves. This is the final, absorbing state with no further requirements for the task. The episode may continue under the environment's own objective, but this reward machine's condition is fully satisfied.
